system_description: A customer support chatbot that handles user inquiries, looks up order status, processes refunds up to $500, and sends emails. It has access to the order database, CRM system, email API, and knowledge base. It retains conversation history across sessions and can chain multiple tools in a single interaction.

suggestions.name: Unique Agent Identity
suggestions.rationale: Agent has unique service identity for database/API access; likely needs stronger isolation between agent and user contexts

suggestions.name: Short-Lived Certificates
suggestions.rationale: Long-lived API keys probable; short-lived certificate rotation not yet implemented

suggestions.name: Hardware Security Module (HSM)
suggestions.rationale: HSM for key protection not implemented; API keys likely stored in environment variables or secrets manager

suggestions.name: Workload Identity Federation
suggestions.rationale: Cloud-native workload identity not configured; using static credentials

suggestions.name: Identity Audit Trail
suggestions.rationale: Basic audit logging exists for tool calls; needs correlation of agent identity across session chains

suggestions.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
suggestions.rationale: Basic role restrictions exist (e.g., refund limit); needs formal RBAC model separating agent vs user permissions

suggestions.name: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)
suggestions.rationale: No attribute-based policies (e.g., user tier, order age) controlling tool access

suggestions.name: On-Behalf-Of (OBO) Flow
suggestions.rationale: Agent acts on user behalf for order lookups; OBO token exchange for email sending needs validation

suggestions.name: Least Privilege Enforcement
suggestions.rationale: Refund cap ($500) enforced; email and CRM permissions need tighter scoping to minimum required

suggestions.name: Tool Scope Validation
suggestions.rationale: No runtime validation that invoked tools match declared agent capabilities or current session context

suggestions.name: Purpose Binding
suggestions.rationale: No enforcement that tool chains stay within stated customer-support purpose; prompt injection could expand scope

suggestions.name: Kill-Switch Capability
suggestions.rationale: Session termination exists; needs real-time kill-switch for active tool execution and conversation chains

suggestions.name: Resource Usage Caps
suggestions.rationale: No rate limits on API calls, refund volume caps, or email send limits per session/user

suggestions.name: Circuit Breakers
suggestions.rationale: No circuit breakers on downstream services (CRM, email API) to prevent cascading failures

suggestions.name: Sandboxed Execution
suggestions.rationale: Tool execution not sandboxed; database queries and email sends run in shared context

suggestions.name: Structured Log Format
suggestions.rationale: Logs exist but inconsistent format; needs structured JSON with agent_id, session_id, tool, user context

suggestions.name: Comprehensive Log Coverage
suggestions.rationale: Tool calls logged; missing full prompt/response content, chain-of-thought, and reasoning trace coverage

suggestions.name: Cryptographic Log Signing
suggestions.rationale: No cryptographic signing of log entries for tamper detection

suggestions.name: Immutable Log Storage
suggestions.rationale: Logs stored in mutable storage; no append-only or immutable log retention

suggestions.name: Real-Time Log Replication
suggestions.rationale: Not applicable for pre-deployment; real-time replication needed only for production monitoring at scale

suggestions.name: Red Team Exercises
suggestions.rationale: No red team exercises conducted; critical for testing prompt injection, tool chaining abuse, and refund bypass

suggestions.name: Automated Vulnerability Scanning
suggestions.rationale: Basic SAST may exist in CI; needs DAST and agentic-specific vulnerability scanning (tool injection, privilege escalation)

suggestions.name: Adversarial Prompt Library
suggestions.rationale: No adversarial prompt library for testing jailbreaks, data exfiltration, and unauthorized tool invocation

suggestions.name: Quarterly Security Validation
suggestions.rationale: No scheduled security validation cadence established

suggestions.name: CI/CD Security Gates
suggestions.rationale: CI pipeline exists; needs security gates for dependency scanning, secret detection, and agent config validation
